headline: Stock Market: Buyers Gain Confidence – Metlen Heading Toward €49, New High for Alpha
summary: Greek equities gained as Metlen moved toward €49, a new high for Alpha, while Brent crude fell toward $82 and European markets held at record highs. Buyers gained confidence.
why: Metlen is a large Greek industrial and energy group listed in Athens, and Brent is the main global crude benchmark that shapes energy costs.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: The article states Brent crude was falling toward $82.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Brent crude falling toward $82 and European markets holding at all-time highs were cited alongside buyer confidence in the Greek market.
